scope: West Campus road/ground alignment, Babcock sidewalk joins, and the bounded Claflin–Sleeper raised public terrace. No Gaffney duplicate street, no whole-campus height reset.

sources.note: Retrieval 2026-10-27 is not acquisition date. Raw samples and service catalogue retained unchanged.

sources.supports: Nickerson playing surface lies below the residence entrance platform; the transition has a substantial retaining face, not uninterrupted undulating grass.
sources.uncertainty: Image upload directory is not a verified capture date; exact wall coordinates/material construction and path widths are not measured.

sources.supports: Relative residence, field, Babcock and Harry Agganis Way connections. Event routing is not a paving survey.

confirmedDefects: Legacy northern 5.2 m blend forced a false Babcock ramp: at x=-2400, z816=5.2 and z852=12.3059 despite independent measured 13.115 and12.950.
Desktop streets omitted the shared BU_SIDEWALK_JOIN_PATCHES already used by mobile.
Raw bare-earth cell (-2340,732)=7.521 falls under the occupied Sleeper/dining assembly; direct rendering created an isolated triangular sinkhole.
The actual Charles ground tile between z350 and590 was skipped by the old minZ600 gate, so (-2364,576) queried6.42597 while its mesh remained5.2.
New terrace meshes originally lacked bounding boxes; this was caught by the runtime loader and corrected before delivery. CampusCollision.rebuild now has a regression test.

implementation.overlap: The existing central DEM progressively takes priority in the shared strip; eastern core heights retain their existing survey.
implementation.terrace: A bounded authored polygon repairs the residence court and shared building base using the stable Sleeper/Claflin samples. Its field-facing boundary is split into separate high and low ground faces at the retaining line; only rear edges and the existing access opening retain a fade. Local drape refinement is limited to this footprint.
implementation.field: Nickerson centre remains7.9213m; the lower playing bowl is explicitly tested and not filled to13m.
implementation.structure: Visible concrete retaining face, bounded three-point-two-metre concrete walk strips; wall geometry is also collision geometry. Existing Babcock→Nickerson touring line has a5.2m wall opening. This retains current access but does not claim full surveyed stairs or accessibility ramps.
implementation.classifications: Topographic samples are measured; residence terrace boundary, retaining alignment, path widths and concrete finish are photo/map-guided approximations. No generic parcel-wide paving fill.
implementation.mobile: createBUWestTerrace returns group/ground/walls/setQuality; root owns actual mobile-campus-build integration and rebake. Isolated constructor tests do not verify the shipped GLB.

resources.terrainNote: Bounded3m edge refinement changes terrain triangle count locally; full street scene remains within the existing400000-triangle and20-material upper bounds.

retainingBoundaryRevision.trigger: Actual terrace-preview/04 still showed a grass slope and no retaining face.
retainingBoundaryRevision.diagnosis: Six CPU rays from the archived walking camera towards wall height11.7 all hit Charles grass3–8m before the wall. A6m exterior terrace fade buried the wall despite correct wall geometry.
retainingBoundaryRevision.correction: The field-facing boundary now has a real height discontinuity. drapeBUGeometry clips triangles at each retaining-wall edge and duplicates boundary vertices with face-interior height samples. The original access opening keeps a local transition; rear terrace edges retain their gradual blend.
retainingBoundaryRevision.northEndNote: The two northern faces meet higher original grade and taper into it; the four field-facing central/southern rays now first-hit the actual wall.
